context.objective: Document how this process works, including controls and what remains unresolved.

turns.text: For the quarterly close we prepare the Excel workbook for financial statement production and the binder. A Fund Accountant updates the activity tabs and later sends the reviewed workbook to FA-12 and binder support to FA-15A.
What information does the Fund Accountant use to update the activity tabs?

The Activities and Tax Activities tabs carry the current client-approved method and activity details: allocation, fees, waivers, waterfall and tax treatment as applicable. Prior-quarter Excel is rolled forward, then the Fund Accountant loads the current TB and records the report run date and username. Review ownership is Fund Accountant preparation, Controller review and Director final review based on complexity; formal workbook approval authority is unconfirmed.
What does the Controller compare or check in the workbook during review?

The Controller reviews workbook and checklist results and returns exceptions. For the Check of Checks every active GL account must be covered by an H- or V-check; every check must equal zero and both clearing accounts 20080 and 20090 must be zero. A zero balance alone could mask incomplete activity. After any later change, the Check of Checks is regenerated, re-reviewed and re-signed.
What workbook changes or results trigger the Check of Checks to be regenerated and re-reviewed?

Any later change triggers regeneration and renewed review and signature; I don't have a narrower list of qualifying changes. During close the Fund Accountant links the statement and lead-sheet tabs to the TB. A cleaned and validated external copy goes to FA-12, while binder support goes to FA-15A; unresolved or nonzero checks prevent binder completion. The internal workbook is retained separately.
What indicates that binder support has finished the binder after receiving the workbook?

Binder support is the package of supporting records, not the person finishing the binder. FA-15A receives those reviewed records. This workbook process is finished when the reviewed internal workbook, cleaned/validated external copy, and binder handoff exist after the required checks and reviews. It does not claim the receiving process has finished its work.
What event or input tells the Fund Accountant to begin preparing the quarterly workbook?

The quarterly close begins and the current-period GL data and client-approved method become available. Binder support collection can start before quarter-end with engagement letters, DTM packages and purchase/sale support. No firmwide completion deadline is documented. About a 5% administration/technology exclusion is an observed accrual practice, not a universal rule.
How does the Fund Accountant know the current-period GL data and client-approved method are ready to use?
